name: open-and-async
description: Draft decision docs, turn meetings into async artifacts, and triage sync vs async in your editor.
long_description: The method from Open and Async, the collaborative software development playbook for remote and distributed teams, as tools your AI assistant can use: draft an ADR from a blank page, turn "let's hop on a call" into an async artifact with an owner and a deadline, score a status update against the "work loudly, no surprises" rubric, and settle sync vs. async with the rule behind the call. Reference tools answer from the book's public summaries, cited and linked. No configuration or API keys.

tools.name: draft_decision_doc
tools.description: Draft a decision doc (ADR) with context, tradeoffs, the call, and reversibility.

tools.name: convert_meeting_to_async
tools.description: Turn a meeting's purpose and agenda into an async artifact with an owner and a deadline.

tools.name: score_status_update
tools.description: Score a status update against the "work loudly, no surprises" rubric.

tools.name: run_async_standup
tools.description: An async standup template your team can adopt.

tools.name: triage_sync_vs_async
tools.description: Recommend sync or async for a task, with the rule behind it.

tools.name: handle_objection
tools.description: Map a common objection to async to a reframe.

tools.name: get_guidance
tools.description: Role-aware guidance for leaders and individual contributors.
